references.label: Sixteen-card matrix
references.description: The center grid tracks Aces through Jacks across four suits.

references.label: Card rollovers
references.description: Sixteen rollovers around the playfield light their matching cards in the center matrix.

references.label: Aces saucer
references.description: The leftmost of four inline saucers starts the full scoring chain.

references.label: Jacks saucer
references.description: The rightmost saucer ends the chain and ejects the ball toward the lower flippers.

references.label: Lower Jack rollovers
references.description: The two lower outside rollovers collect Jacks but sit on dangerous side-drain paths.

references.label: Top-center Special rollover
references.description: The center rollover above the upper bumpers can light for Special after all four Clubs are collected.
